status.en: 9 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 80% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 9 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 80 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syrian authorities arrested a former regime officer accused of orchestrating a 2014 massacre near Damascus and an ex-general linked to the same ambush, while a commander from the Al-Assad era was detained for involvement in the Al-Otaiba ambush. Security forces also seized a drug dealer in eastern Deir Ezzor and investigated suspected sabotage of a gas pipeline in the same region. A landmine blast injured three people in Aleppo, and Saudi and Syrian foreign ministers met to discuss regional security cooperation. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske myndigheter arresterte en tidligere regimoffiser som er anklaget for å ha orkestrert et massakre i 2014 nær Damaskus, og en eks-general knyttet til samme bakholdsangrep, mens en kommandør fra Al-Assad-æraen ble pågrepet for deltakelse i Al-Otaiba-bakholdet. Sikkerhetsstyrkene tok også en narkotikahandler i østlige Deir ez-Zor, og etterforsker påstått sabotasje av en gassrørledning i samme region. En landmineeksplosjon såret tre personer i Aleppo, og Saudi-Arabias og Syriens utenriksministre møttes for å diskutere regionalt sikkerhetssamarbeid. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
